grammar.title: 进度
lines: While Alfred's little army slowly began to gather at Athelney, the king himself set out to penetrate the camp of Guthrum, the commander of the Danish invaders. little adj. trivial; insignificant 微不足道的 gather v. assemble; collect; mass; congregate … 聚集；收集；集合 set out to do 开始做...；有意做某事 penetrate (into / through) 进入、穿过（尤其表示费力、有抵抗力的情况下） Guthrum 丹麦人的国王古特仑（历史人物）Danish king, he was forced to accept baptism after being defeated by Alfred. These had settled down for the winter at Chippenham: thither Alfred went . settle down 定居下来、安顿下来；安静下来 He noticed at once that discipline was slack : the Danes had the self-confidence of conquerors, and their security precautions were casual. Discipline is slack / loose / lax 纪律松懈 precautions 防范措施 casual adj. slack; careless; inattentive 松懈的；马虎的；不经意的 They lived well, on the proceeds of raids on neighbouring regions. live by doing 靠(通过)某种职业为生 live on sth. 靠(依赖)某种食物或生活来源为生（指人） proceeds 做某事或卖某事的收益 the money that is obtained from doing sth. or selling sth. raid on 对...的抢劫/突袭 neighboring adj. nearby 临近的 There they collected women as well as food and drink, and a life of ease had made them soft. as well as... 除了...之外还... （强调前者） soft adj.If you are soft on someone, you do not treat them as strictly or severely as you should. 软弱可欺;心慈手软的
She complained about every little problem.
The error was so little that it was ignored.
He paid little attention to the warning.
A large crowd began to gather in the square. 聚集
She was trying to gather information for her report. 收集
The whole family gathered for Christmas. 集合
Dimitri at once set out to find the thief .
The journalist immediately set out to obtain these important facts, but he took a long time to send them .
True eccentrics never deliberately set out to draw attention to themselves . 从未故意打算吸引
We never set out to hurt you, Victor. And I'm sorry we did. Are you done? Yeah. 从未有意要伤害
Our troops have penetrated (into) enemy territory. 我们的部队已进入敌方领土。
trespass on 非法进入 I accused him of trespassing on my estate. 非法进入
Trespassers 闯入者 Trespassers will be prosecuted . 闯入者将被起诉。
Guthrum was the commander of the Danish invaders.
Alfred defeated Guthrum and forced him to accept baptism.
The Treaty of Wedmore established boundaries between Alfred's kingdom and Guthrum's territory.
They’d like to see their daughter settle down, get married and have kids.
After a long journey, we finally settled down in our new apartment.
The children settled down to watch the film.
He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country .
The manager warned that discipline was slack in the department.
The school enforced stricter rules because the discipline was loose.
Lax discipline led to many mistakes.
What are Universal Precautions? 什么是普遍预防措施？
Precautions before mining a website. 挖掘网站之前的注意事项。
What precautions should we take? 以及我们应该对此做些什么准备呢？
security precautions 安保措施 Their security precautions安保措施 were casual.
safety precautions 安全防范措施 Always follow safety precautions安全防范措施 when using power tools.
fire precautions 防火措施 The building must meet all fire precautions防火措施 regulations.
sanitary precautions 卫生保健措施 Take necessary sanitary precautions卫生保健措施 when preparing food.
His manner was very casual about the important meeting. 态度松懈
The students were casual about their deadlines. 不在意
The security checks were surprisingly casual.安保检查出人意料地马虎
He lives by writing. 他靠写作谋生
He lives by sewing. 他靠缝纫为生
The nomads who made these markings lived by hunting and fishing during the last Ice Age ... 靠狩猎和捕鱼为生
He lives on meat and milk. 靠某种食物为生
He lives on salary. 靠生活来源为生
He still lives on his parents despite having a job. 啃老
feed on sth. 动物以...为主食 Cows feed on hay. 牛以干草为主食
prey on sth. 肉食性动物以别的动物为食 Owls prey on mice. 猫头鹰捕食老鼠
The proceeds of the concert will go to charity. 音乐会的收益
The family received the proceeds from the sale of the house. 出售的收益
proceeds of / from sth. 做某事或卖某事的收益 We will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling Stockholders. 公司将不会获得售股股东出售股份得到的任何收入。
The police carried out a raid on the jeweler's shop . 对珠宝店的抢劫
They launched an air raid on the military base. 对军事基地的空袭
The soldiers conducted a surprise raid on the camp. 对营地的突袭
The two countries are neighboring states. 这两个国家是临近的
They often visit the neighboring regions. 临近地区
She borrowed a cup of sugar from her neighboring flat. 临近的
She speaks French as well as Spanish. 除了...之外还有...
He's got plenty of brains as well as brawn. 他四肢发达，头脑也不简单。
This year numerous bands are playing, as well as comedy acts. 今年有许多乐队在表演，也有喜剧节目。
in addition to... 除了...之外还... There they collected women in addition to food and drink.
besides... 除了...之外还... There they collected women besides food and drink.
along with... 除了...之外还... There they collected women along with food and drink.
together with... 除了...之外还... There they collected women together with food and drink.
aside from... 除了...之外还... There they collected women aside from food and drink.
apart from... 除了...之外还... There they collected women apart from food and drink.
not only... but also... 不仅...而且... （强调后者） There they collected not only food and drink but also women.
If you appear to be soft, people will take advantage of you. 如果你显得软弱可欺
The army had become soft after years of peace. 军队已经变得软弱
Don't go soft on them; they deserve the punishment. 不要变软弱

sentences.title: 进入敌营
lines: Alfred stayed in the camp a week before he returned to Athelney. before 的译法:然后；才；就 The force there assembled was trivial compared with the Danish horde. assembled / gathered / massed 聚集的（作后置定语） The force (which was) assembled / gathered / massed there was trivial … compared to / with... 与...相比 But Alfred had deduced that the Danes were no longer fit for prolonged battle : and that their commissariat had no organization, but depended on irregular raids . be fit for... / to do... 适合做某事（达到好的标准） no... but... 不是...而是...
It will be a long time before we meet again.(强调主句时间长) adv.才
... the bell struck thirteen times before it stopped . (强调主句时间长) adv.才
I hadn’t waited long before he came. (强调主句时间短) 就
I shaved before I went to the party. (连词) 然后
..., but I decided to disembark before I bought anything. (连词) 然后
..., but I decided to disembark before buying anything. (介词) 然后
The force there assembled was trivial... 聚集的军队
The information gathered was crucial to the investigation. 收集到的信息
The crowd massed outside the building was enormous. 聚集的人群
The force there assembled was trivial compared with the Danish horde.
The room was light and lofty compared to the basement. 这个房间与地下室比起来更亮更高。
I was at a disadvantage compared to the younger members of the team. 与队里较年轻的队员相比，我处于不利地位。
in / by contrast to / with... 与...相比 In contrast with his previous work, this film is much darker.
in / by comparison to / with... 与...相比 His salary is low by comparison with other managers.
The food is fit for human consumption.食物适合人类食用
Chickens slaughtered in the United States, claim officials in Brussels, are not fit to grace European tables .不适合摆上欧洲餐桌
He is fit for the job. 他适合这份工作
Their commissariat had no organization, but depended on irregular raids.
There was no one in the room but me. 房间里除了...之外没有别人
He is no musician but a composer. 他不是一个演奏者，而是一个作曲家
not... but... 不是...而是... The problem is not the cost but the time. 不是...而是
not that..., but that... 不是因为...而是因为... Not that I love Caesar less, but that I love Rome more.不是我爱凯撒少，而是我爱罗马多

expand.title: 知己知彼
lines: So, faced with the Danish advance, Alfred did not risk open battle but harried the enemy. be faced with 面对着 risk sth. / doing 冒着...的风险 He was constantly on the move, drawing the Danes after him. on the + noun 处于某种状态 on + noun (没有"the") 处于某种状态 His patrols halted the raiding parties: hunger assailed the Danish army. party 一群人；一队人 无灵主语 高级写作（非人称事物作主语） The Danish army suffered from hunger. 普通写法 Now Alfred began a long series of skirmishes -- and within a month the Danes had surrendered . series of 一系列 The episode could reasonably serve as a unique epic of royal espionage! reasonably adv. justifiably; legitimately adv. 合理地；相当地；适度地 be unique to... / be peculiar to... 对...来说是独一无二的；是...独有的
She is faced with a difficult decision.
We must be prepared to be faced with unexpected challenges.
be confronted with 面临着 The company was suddenly confronted with a financial crisis.
They risked their lives to save the trapped climbers. 他们冒着生命危险
We couldn't risk being caught in a storm.冒着被暴风雨困住的风险
You should never risk your health for money.
instead of... 代替；而不是 Alfred harried the enemy instead of risking open battle. 而不是冒着公开战斗的风险
in preference to... 优先于；而不是 Alfred harried the enemy in preference to risking open battle. 而不是冒着公开战斗的风险
in place of... 代替；而不是 Alfred harried the enemy in place of risking open battle. 而不是冒着公开战斗的风险
rather than... (副词短语) 而不是 Alfred harried the enemy rather than risked open battle. 而不是冒着公开战斗的风险
rather than... (连接相同结构) 而不是 She telephoned rather than wrote. 她打了电话而不是写信
rather than... (连接相同结构) 而不是 He is to be pitied rather than to be disliked. 他值得同情而不是被讨厌
on the move 在移动中；忙碌 He was constantly on the move.他不断地在移动中
on the alert 警惕着 The dog is on the alert.狗警惕着
on the go 忙碌着 He is always on the go.他总是忙碌着
on the recovery 正在康复中 The patient is on the recovery.病人正在康复中
on the rise 在上升 Crimes are on the rise.犯罪正在上升
on display 展出 ...examples of modern sculpture on display in public places.
on sale 出售 The house is on sale.房子在出售
on strike 罢工 The workers are on strike.工人在罢工
on vacation 度假 I’m here on vacation.我在这里度假
on business 出差 I’m here on business.我在这里出差
on call 随时待命 The nurse is on call 24 hours a day. 护士随时待命
The only regular visitors to the monastery in winter are parties of skiers who go there at Christmas and Easter .
The mountain rescue team organized a search party. 搜寻队
A rescue party was immediately dispatched to the scene.
Panic seized me. 恐慌攫住了
Curiosity swallowed him. 好奇心吞噬了
Confidence deserted him. 信心离开了
That night sleep eluded me. 睡眠躲避了
Sunset met them halfway. 日落遇到了
The past few years witnessed the great influx of foreigners to China,for travelling, studies or business. 过去几年见证了
Alfred began a long series of skirmishes.一系列小规模战斗

be unique to... 对...来说是独一无二的 Each set of genes is unique to the individual.对个体来说是独一无二的
